meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会作为对抗式规划组长:先说固定开场白 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!,再调度 5 个互相敌对的评审互相挑刺;扛过攻击的结论才保留,并强制交给 plan 智能体写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等触发词,或要求做极高严谨度的对抗式规划、找出薄弱假设/盲点/过度设计时触发;仅在主会话、团队模式可用时运行。

say.text: hyperplan:帮我把支付模块重构做成对抗式规划
say.note: 先进入对抗模式,结论最后由 plan 成文。

say.text: hpp:找出一份方案里最脆弱的假设和过度设计
say.note: 5 个敌对评审会轮流攻击,扛得住的结论才保留。

say.text: 用 /hyperplan 交叉批判这个技术选型
say.note: 评审结论会强制交给 plan 智能体落成计划。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as the lead of an adversarial planning team: announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', spawns 5 hostile reviewers to attack the plan, keeps surviving insights only, and hands them to the plan agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan' or similar trigger words, or ask for adversarial cross-critique planning with maximum rigor. Works only in the main session with team-mode tools available.

say_en.text: hyperplan: run an adversarial plan for the payment module refactor.
say_en.note: It attacks, then the plan agent writes the plan.

say_en.text: hpp: find the weakest assumptions and over-engineering in this proposal.
say_en.note: Only points that survive the critique are kept.

say_en.text: Use /hyperplan to cross-critique this tech choice.
say_en.note: The plan agent formalizes the distilled insights.
